answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because nectar only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, pearl is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any nebula approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
